description: Source file implementing RRC (Radio Resource Control) message handling for UE (User Equipment) in a 5G NR network, including procedures for setup, reestablishment, reconfiguration, handover, and security.

classes.name: rrc_ue_impl
classes.description: Implementation of UE RRC message handling, including procedures for connection setup, reestablishment, reconfiguration, handover, security, and measurement reporting.

methods.name: handle_ul_ccch_pdu
methods.description: Handles incoming UL-CCCH PDU, parses message, and dispatches to specific handlers based on message type.

methods.name: handle_rrc_setup_request
methods.description: Processes RRC Setup Request, performs checks, and initiates RRC setup procedure.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reest_request
methods.description: Processes RRC Reestablishment Request, performs checks, and initiates reestablishment procedure.

methods.name: handle_rrc_resume_request
methods.description: Handles RRC Resume Request, falls back to RRC Setup if necessary, or initiates resume procedure.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing transactions and procedures.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Handles incoming UL-DCCH PDU, parses message, and dispatches to specific handlers.

methods.name: handle_ul_dcch_pdu
methods.description: Processes UL-DCCH PDUs, unpacks PDCP PDU, and dispatches contained RRC messages.

methods.name: handle_security_mode_complete
methods.description: Configures security settings upon receiving Security Mode Complete message.

methods.name: handle_ul_info_transfer
methods.description: Processes UL NAS transport messages and forwards to NGAP.

methods.name: handle_measurement_report
methods.description: Processes measurement reports and forwards results to measurement manager.

methods.name: handle_dl_nas_transport_message
methods.description: Handles downlink NAS transport messages, stores if UE inactive, or forwards via DL-DCCH.

methods.name: handle_rrc_transaction_complete
methods.description: Marks RRC transaction as complete upon receiving corresponding response.

methods.name: get_security_mode_command_context
methods.description: Prepares and returns context for Security Mode Command, including packing the message.

methods.name: handle_rrc_ue_capability_transfer_request
methods.description: Initiates UE Capability Transfer procedure.

methods.name: get_rrc_ue_release_context
methods.description: Prepares RRC release message, either RRCReject or RRCRelease, based on context.

methods.name: get_transfer_context
methods.description: Gathers and returns transfer context for UE mobility or handover.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Returns reestablishment context including security, capabilities, and state.

methods.name: get_rrc_handover_command
methods.description: Creates and returns RRC Handover Command message based on request.

methods.name: handle_rrc_handover_command
methods.description: Processes received Handover Command, unpacks reconfiguration, and prepares for execution.

methods.name: store_ue_capabilities
methods.description: Unpacks and stores UE capabilities from received buffer.

methods.name: handle_rrc_handover_preparation_info
methods.description: Processes Handover Preparation Info message and stores UE capabilities.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Handles RRC Reconfiguration Request and initiates reconfiguration procedure.

methods.name: get_rrc_ue_handover_reconfiguration_context
methods.description: Prepares reconfiguration context for handover, including ASN.1 encoding.

methods.name: get_rrc_ue_cond_reconfiguration_context
methods.description: Prepares conditional reconfiguration context with measurement configs and candidates.

methods.name: handle_handover_reconfiguration_complete_expected
methods.description: Waits for reconfiguration complete message after handover, with timeout.

methods.name: get_serving_cell_mo
methods.description: Returns measurement object for serving cell, generating config if needed.

methods.name: generate_meas_config
methods.description: Generates measurement configuration based on current settings and candidate PCI list.

methods.name: get_packed_meas_config
methods.description: Returns ASN.1 encoded measurement configuration.

methods.name: get_packed_ue_capability_rat_container_list
methods.description: Returns ASN.1 packed UE capability RAT container list.

methods.name: get_packed_ue_radio_access_cap_info
methods.description: Returns ASN.1 packed UE radio access capability info.
